subject: Term Amendment & Capacity Addendum — Invoice/PO Routing
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@skylark-ai.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@skylark-ai.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal amendment + PO for extra capacity

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We are ready to move forward with the renewal, but need to confirm a couple of billing items before the purchase order is routed. High level:

- We want to increase the committed capacity by 40% for the Dedicated pool (from 5 GPUs -> 7 GPUs) for the 12-month term.
- Procurement asked if we can get an updated invoice showing the new monthly committed amount and an addendum referencing the capacity change.
- Our accounts team requires Redwood's W-9 and a consolidated invoice template for PO processing.

I'll attach the draft PO once procurement OKs it, but wanted to confirm net terms. Previously we were on Net 30; procurement is asking for Net 45 to align with their vendor calendar. Are you able to accept Net 45 for this renewal? Also, can you confirm the billing contact/email for invoicing (to be included on the PO)?

Would appreciate a short confirmation and any documents you can send over today so procurement can start routing the PO.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Cloud Ops | Skylark AI
[lena.ortiz@skylark-ai.com]

[Attachment: Skylark_Draft_PO_4982.pdf (pdf)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@skylark-ai.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment + PO for extra capacity

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear note. Happy to confirm a few things and loop in Finance to get the paperwork right. Summary answers below: 

- Capacity: we can add the 2 GPU equivalent (40% increase) to your Dedicated pool for the 12-month renewal. We'll show the delta on the invoice and include a Capacity Addendum referencing deal RNWL-4982.
- Net terms: Finance will accept Net 45 for this renewal as a one-time amendment tied to the PO. We need the PO number on the invoice header.
- Billing contact: please route invoices to billing@redwood.com and cc: finance+skylark@redwood.com (we will provide a billing alias that maps to our AR team). If Procurement requires a named contact, the billing contact is Vanessa Ortiz, Billing Operations — vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com.
- Tax docs: we'll attach a copy of our current W-9 and a sample consolidated invoice template.

I've attached the Capacity Addendum draft and copied Marcus from Finance to confirm the net term exception. If those look good, we can sign the addendum and you can upload the PO to DocuSign or reply with the PO PDF.

Next step: Marcus, can you confirm acceptance from Finance and provide the invoice template we should send to Skylark? 

Best,
Dylan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[dylan_brooks@redwood.com]

[Attachments: Redwood_Capacity_Addendum_v2.docx, Redwood_W9_2028.pdf]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@skylark-ai.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 12:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment + PO for extra capacity

Thanks Dylan — Finance confirms: Net 45 approved for this renewal, one-off exception tied to PO/Deal RNWL-4982. Requirements on our side: PO must cite the deal id and show total committed monthly charge and effective dates.

I've attached the invoice template (PDF) and our AR instructions — please ensure procurement includes the PO number and the billing alias 'billing@redwood.com' on the header. Once we receive the signed addendum and the PO, we'll queue the first invoice for the new term.

Also, note that for tax purposes we need either a completed W-9 from Skylark (if US entity) or a W-8BEN from a non-US entity. Lena, could you confirm which applies and upload the tax form?

Marcus Lin
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
[marcus_lin@redwood.com]

[Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template_2028.pdf]

From: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@skylark-ai.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@skylark-ai.com>, procurement@skylark-ai.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment + PO for extra capacity

Marcus / Dylan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement confirmed Skylark is a US entity and we attached a completed W-9 (Skylark_W9_2028.pdf).

Attached is our draft PO that references RNWL-4982 and the new capacity counts. Please review and confirm the PO number (proposed: SK-PO-29817) is acceptable and that the billing alias is correct. Procurement prefers we upload the signed addendum + PO into DocuSign to complete the workflow.

Quick FYI — Skylark prefers payment on Net 45, and they will include the PO number on all invoices. If Redwood needs a specific AR contact for exception handling, let us know.

Thanks,
Carlos Mendes
Procurement Manager | Skylark AI
[c.mendes@skylark-ai.com]

[Attachments: Skylark_PO_addendum_4982.pdf, Skylark_W9_2028.pdf]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@skylark-ai.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@skylark-ai.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 15:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment + PO for extra capacity

Perfect — thanks for sending the PO and W-9. Confirmations below and next steps: 

- PO number SK-PO-29817 accepted. Please upload signed PO + signed Capacity Addendum to the DocuSign link you shared (we'll countersign within 24 hours).
- Billing alias: billing@redwood.com (primary). AR contact for escalations: Vanessa Ortiz, Billing Operations — vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com; phone +1 (415) 555-0143.
- We'll issue the first invoice for the adjusted committed amount on the effective start date in the addendum and honor Net 45.
- Attached: final Capacity Addendum (redlines accepted) and our invoice with the PO number pre-filled for your records.

Action items: Lena/Carlos — upload the signed addendum + PO to DocuSign and confirm when complete. Marcus/Vanessa — prepare AR to send the initial invoice once DocuSign completes.

Thanks all — excited to continue scaling with Skylark.

Best,
Dylan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[dylan_brooks@redwood.com]

[Attachments: Skylark_PO_addendum_4982_signed.pdf, Redwood_Invoice_SK-PO-29817.pdf]
